description: Private AI meeting note taker with local audio capture, transcription, summaries, and searchable notes.
notes: This 64-bit package extracts the verified NSIS 3.13 payload with 7-Zip instead of running the installer. The bundled WebView2 bootstrapper is skipped; Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime must already be installed. Use Scoop for updates rather than the in-app updater.
